description_for_model: Youyin GEO System is a brand AI-visibility diagnostic and monitoring tool. Core features: (1) GEO diagnosis — input a URL or brand name to get a 7-dimension diagnostic report (cite-ability, authority/E-E-A-T, schema, content depth, technical, entity consistency, and AI indexing measured live on Doubao and DeepSeek) with a radar chart, gap list, and prioritized optimization suggestions generated by Claude Code; (2) AI visibility monitoring — track brand mention rate, ranking, citations, and scenario hit rate (recognition/recommendation/evaluation) across mainstream AI engines. Locally deployed with Claude Code + n8n; customers bring their own API keys (BYOK).
description_for_human: 品牌 AI 可见性（GEO）诊断与监控系统
